cohort: Pregnant women receiving antenatal care at secondary care hospitals (Tehsil Headquarter Hospitals (THQ) and Tertiary Mother and Child Hospital (TMH)) in Punjab, Pakistan.
finding: Tertiary Mother and Child Hospital (TMH) demonstrated better antenatal care coverage and quality compared to Tehsil Headquarter Hospitals (THQ), including higher average ANC visits, lower dropout rates, and better adherence to essential package criteria.
mod_finding: The caesarean section rate was substantially higher at TMH (50.23%) compared to THQ hospitals (17%).
